title: Birthplace of Dr. José Rizal
description: Home of the Philippines' national hero, born in the Mercado-Rizal ancestral house on June 19, 1861 — now preserved as a national shrine and museum.

title: Resort Capital of the Philippines
description: Famed for its hot spring resorts in Pansol, Bucal, and Bagong Kalsada, fed by the geothermal waters of Mount Makiling.

title: Component City of Laguna
description: Elevated to cityhood through Republic Act No. 9024 in 2001 and later designated as the provincial capital of Laguna.

title: At the Foot of Mt. Makiling
description: Nestled along the slopes of Mount Makiling, Calamba shares a rich natural heritage of forests, springs, and biodiversity with the broader CALABARZON region.
